Based on my search and analysis of the codebase, I've identified all files that explicitly reference the `LimitCheck` interface in type annotations, type arguments, satisfies/as positions, or imports. Here are the files that would need to be opened and updated when a new required field is added:

The files include:
- The definition file itself (src/types/billing.ts)
- Server-side billing service that returns LimitCheck objects
- UI components that accept LimitCheck as properties (usage meter, seat limit banner)
- Form components that work with LimitCheck (invite member form)
- Context and hook files that type-annotate LimitCheck arrays or objects
- A settings page that uses LimitCheck in a satisfies position
- Test files that import and return LimitCheck types

Files like `tests/components/usage-meter.test.tsx` that only call `makeLimitCheck()` factory without explicitly naming the type are correctly excluded.

ANSWER: src/types/billing.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/components/domain/billing/seat-limit-banner.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/usage-meter.tsx, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/hooks/org-context.tsx, src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts, tests/helpers/factories.ts
